ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME BEGIN
local lmr={owner="e80124"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end
function lmr.getTransformForward(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformForward()) end
function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end
function lmr.getTransformUp(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformUp()) end
function lmr.copy(p) local q={};for k,v in pairs(p)do q[k]=v end;return q end
function lmr.cast(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.origin then q.origin=lmr.point(q.origin) end
 if q.direction then q.direction=lmr.point(q.direction) end
 if q.orientation then q.orientation=lmr.rotation(q.orientation) end
 local hits=Physics.cast(q)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
  if hit.point then hit.point=lmr.point(hit.point)end
  if hit.normal then hit.normal=lmr.point(hit.normal)end
 end
 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME END
function setNeon(p) end
function onLoad() self.setLock(true); self.interactable=false end

-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME BEGIN
local lmr={owner="e80124"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end
function lmr.getTransformForward(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformForward()) end
function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end
function lmr.getTransformUp(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformUp()) end
function lmr.copy(p) local q={};for k,v in pairs(p)do q[k]=v end;return q end
function lmr.cast(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.origin then q.origin=lmr.point(q.origin) end
 if q.direction then q.direction=lmr.point(q.direction) end
 if q.orientation then q.orientation=lmr.rotation(q.orientation) end
 local hits=Physics.cast(q)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
  if hit.point then hit.point=lmr.point(hit.point)end
  if hit.normal then hit.normal=lmr.point(hit.normal)end
 end
 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME END
local paths=JSON.decode("[{\"points\":[[-0.6099999999999999,1.611111111111111,-0.09],[-0.6099999999999999,2.1083333333333334,-0.09],[0.6099999999999999,2.1083333333333334,-0.09],[0.6099999999999999,1.611111111111111,-0.09]],\"color\":[1,0.12,0.7],\"thickness\":0.025}]")
-- OBJ_LOCAL_LINES: exported model X is reflected from authoring coordinates.
for _,line in ipairs(paths)do for _,v in ipairs(line.points or{})do v[1]=-v[1]end end
function setNeon(p)
 if self.isDestroyed() or #paths==0 then return end
 local enabled=p==nil or p.enabled~=false
 self.setVectorLines(enabled and paths or {})
end
local function refresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() then return end
 local c=getObjectFromGUID('e80124')
 setNeon({enabled=not c or c.getVar('neonEnabled')~=false})
 self.setLock(true)
end
function onLoad() Wait.frames(refresh,4);Wait.frames(refresh,60) end
function onStateChange(oldGuid) Wait.frames(refresh,4);Wait.frames(refresh,60) end

 local mat=universalMat();if not mat then return end

 for _,center in ipairs(doubleBindCenters)do jobs[#jobs+1]={center=center,color={1,.78,.16},points={},top={}}end
 for _,x in ipairs({-4,4})do jobs[#jobs+1]={x=x,color={.83,.35,1},points={},top={}}end
 local index,sample=1,0;local strokes={};local scale=mat.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local function step()
  if generation~=doubleBindGuideGeneration or self.isDestroyed()or not universalMat()then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local job=jobs[index]
   if not job then doubleBindGuides=strokes;universalCommit();return end
   local x,z
   if job.center then local a=sample*2*math.pi/96;x=job.center[1]+60/25.4*math.cos(a);z=job.center[2]+60/25.4*math.sin(a)
   else x=job.x;z=-24+sample*.5 end

    end end
   end

   sample=sample+1
   if sample>96 then
    loboInk(mat,strokes,job.points,job.center and 'scoring' or 'exclusion')
    sample=0;index=index+1
   end
  end

 end

-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME BEGIN
local lmr={owner="e80124"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end
function lmr.getTransformForward(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformForward()) end
function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end
function lmr.getTransformUp(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformUp()) end
function lmr.copy(p) local q={};for k,v in pairs(p)do q[k]=v end;return q end
function lmr.cast(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.origin then q.origin=lmr.point(q.origin) end
 if q.direction then q.direction=lmr.point(q.direction) end
 if q.orientation then q.orientation=lmr.rotation(q.orientation) end
 local hits=Physics.cast(q)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
  if hit.point then hit.point=lmr.point(hit.point)end
  if hit.normal then hit.normal=lmr.point(hit.normal)end
 end
 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME END
local all={'White','Brown','Red','Orange','Yellow','Green','Teal','Blue','Purple','Pink','Grey','Black'}
function setPaperVisible(p)self.setInvisibleTo(p.enabled and{}or all)end
function onLoad()
 self.setLock(true);self.interactable=false
 self.setInvisibleTo(all)
 Wait.condition(function()
  for _,kind in ipairs({'BoxCollider','SphereCollider','MeshCollider','CapsuleCollider'})do for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren(kind)or{})do c.set('enabled',false)end end

 end,function()return not self.loading_custom end,30)
end

function setNeon(p)end

-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME BEGIN
local lmr={owner="e80124"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end
function lmr.getTransformForward(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformForward()) end
function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end
function lmr.getTransformUp(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformUp()) end
function lmr.copy(p) local q={};for k,v in pairs(p)do q[k]=v end;return q end
function lmr.cast(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.origin then q.origin=lmr.point(q.origin) end
 if q.direction then q.direction=lmr.point(q.direction) end
 if q.orientation then q.orientation=lmr.rotation(q.orientation) end
 local hits=Physics.cast(q)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
  if hit.point then hit.point=lmr.point(hit.point)end
  if hit.normal then hit.normal=lmr.point(hit.normal)end
 end
 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME END
local function illuminate()
 if self.isDestroyed()or self.loading_custom then return end
 self.setLock(true);self.interactable=false
 if self.AssetBundle then
  pcall(function()if self.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffectIndex()~=2 then self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(2)end end)
 end
 for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('Light')or{})do
  c.set('renderMode',1);c.set('enabled',true);c.set('range',2.0);c.set('intensity',4.05)
  pcall(function()c.set('color',Color(.45,.85,1,1));c.set('shadows',0)end)
 end
 for _,r in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('MeshRenderer')or{})do r.set('enabled',false)end
 for _,kind in ipairs({'BoxCollider','SphereCollider','MeshCollider','CapsuleCollider'})do
  for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren(kind)or{})do c.set('enabled',false)end
 end
end
function onLoad()
 Wait.condition(illuminate,function()return not self.loading_custom end,30)
 Wait.frames(illuminate,120);Wait.frames(illuminate,300)
end
